dial.summary: Hot September CPI (3.7% YoY, core 2.6%) confirmed Oct 14 has intensified macro headwinds — DXY surged to 102.52 close, real yields hold at 2.88%, and stablecoin dominance spiked to 10.75% signaling within-crypto risk-off rotation; Global M2 ($103.7T expanding) and near-zero BTC funding (0.003%) remain structural tailwinds, TOTAL at ~$2.86T has not broken down and BTC.D holds firm at 59.3%, sustaining the Accumulation regime — dial flips to Risk Off on confirmed TOTAL breakdown below $2.7T.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) confirmed at ~$103,649B per Oct 13, 2026 tracker snapshot — August 2026 remains the latest month with all four economies reporting; 4-week trend UP (July $102,638B → August $103,649B, +$1,011B, +1.0% MoM); US M2 at $23.34T for August (FRED H.6, next September release Oct 27); status supportive per rule (supportive if 4-week trend is up); no September G4 aggregate yet (6–8 week lag); next full G4 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI confirmed at 54.5% (released Oct 1, 2026; August 54.6%, 4-week change −0.1pp within flat threshold); New Orders 55.3, Production 56.7, Employment growing, Prices Paid 77.9% (multi-year high); status neutral — above 50 but not rising on 4-week basis; October PMI not yet available; next release November 2, 2026.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot at 102.52 (Oct 14, 2026 close per Trading Economics); surged intraday to ~102.90 (18-month high) after September CPI beat (3.7% YoY, +0.6% MoM, released Oct 14 at 8:30 AM ET); 4-week trend UP from ~99.90 on Sep 13 to 102.52 (+2.6%); status headwind (above 100 threshold); FOMC Oct 27–28 next major catalyst — a 25bp hike to 4.00%–4.25% could push DXY through 103.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.88% as of October 13, 2026 (FRED via tipswatch/macrotrends; Oct 9 reading was 2.91%); 4-week trend UP from ~2.52% on Sep 9 to 2.88% (+36bps); 52-week range 1.68%–2.95% — near multi-year highs; status headwind (rising on 4-week basis and well above 2% threshold); hot September CPI (3.7% YoY) supports further upward pressure into FOMC Oct 27–28.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 14, 2026: 10Y 5.19%, 2Y 4.82% → spread = +37bps (FRED T10Y2Y = 0.37 on Oct 14; prior Oct 13 = 0.42); 4-week trend flat (Sep 9 ~42bps → Oct 14 37bps = −5bps, at the flat/down boundary; borderline call); status neutral — curve remains positively sloped but has narrowed modestly; hot CPI and hike bets compressed the spread on Oct 14; FOMC Oct 27–28 is the next major curve catalyst.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,747,560M ($6.748T) for week ending October 7, 2026 (most recent confirmed H.4.1; prior week Sep 30 = $6,743,031M); 4-week trend flat: Sep 9 ~$6,737B → Oct 7 $6,748B = +$11B (+0.16%); status supportive (flat at post-QT-pause stabilization plateau); new H.4.1 release covering week ending Oct 14 due today Oct 15 at 4:30 PM ET — not yet available at time of this run.

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC weighted 8h perp funding rate at ~0.0029% as of October 14, 2026 (Au79 Macro Research citing CoinGlass, corroborated by Glassnode at ~0.002%); 30-day trend DOWN from ~0.0067% on Sep 30 to ~0.003% on Oct 14; status supportive (well below 0.04% overheating threshold — near-zero funding confirms spot-driven accumulation, not leveraged speculation); hot September CPI has not yet elevated funding into overheated territory.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: All-currency stablecoin market cap ~$307.0B on October 14, 2026 (Au79 Macro Research citing CoinGecko) vs total crypto ~$2.856T → stablecoin dominance ~10.75%; 30-day trend UP (Sep 15 est. ~10.5% → Oct 14 10.75%, +0.25pp); status headwind — stablecoin dominance rising on 30-day basis while total crypto market cap is also rising (~$2.856T), indicating capital rotating into stablecoins faster than risk assets; likely triggered by hot September CPI (3.7% YoY) on Oct 14; USD-pegged stablecoins at ~$303.4B (USDT dominant).

upcoming.title: Industrial Production & Capacity Utilization (September 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve Board releases September 2026 Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization at 9:15 AM ET; completes the Q3 output picture ahead of the GDP advance estimate (October 29); September ISM Manufacturing at 54.5% and Production sub-index growing suggest solid output; a miss would reinforce stagflation risk (hot prices, softening activity) into the October 27–28 FOMC.

upcoming.title: Housing Starts & Building Permits (September 2026)
upcoming.note: Census Bureau releases September 2026 Housing Starts and Building Permits at 8:30 AM ET; with real yields at 2.88% and mortgage rates elevated, continued monthly declines would underscore the drag from high financing costs on residential investment; provides incremental Q3 data ahead of the October 29 GDP advance estimate.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended October 18, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended October 18, 2026 — last major labor data point before the October 27–28 FOMC decision; a sustained trend above 220K across multiple weeks would raise recession risk; carries outsized weight given the September NFP of +29K and hot CPI backdrop.
